cause: The OBDD node-cap exception escaped build_bdd_from_raw before its partial BDD/raw-DAG/recursion counters were returned to run_obdd. The CAP_HIT handler therefore had no live partial build object and defaulted already-spent construction work to zero.
scientific_effect: Semantic matrix classifications were not promoted beyond finite scope, but the typed cost ledger violated the frozen law that failed construction/search work must be charged. The original receipt is retained and not rewritten.

repair.rule: Construct OBDD in the caller-visible scope and, on CAP_HIT, serialize the partial BDD and charge bdd_ops + raw_restriction_ops + recursion_calls. Controls and all caps remain unchanged.
